invariants.rationale: The result is either 0, or the output of an interpolation function, which typically returns values in [0,1].
The visual interpolation function commonly returns values between 0 and 1 inclusive; returning 0 when min == max makes 1.0 an upper bound.
If min equals max, the method returns 0 directly by implementation.
If min and max are not equal, the else branch executes, otherwise result is always 0.
When min != max, result is the interpolation value; otherwise, handled by earlier invariants.
